## NEW TO COVERAGE (never read before) — the Foundry Skills API (preview)
Endpoint: **`{FOUNDRY_PROJECT_ENDPOINT}/skills`**   ms.date 2026-08-05, updated_at 2026-08-07
- A skill is a `SKILL.md` per the **agentskills.io** spec: YAML front matter `name` (URL path key,
  `^[a-z0-9]([a-z0-9\-]*[a-z0-9])?$`, max 64, MUST be unquoted) + `description` (max 1,024,
  unquoted); Markdown body "becomes the skill's injected instructions".
- **Versioning:** creating a version AUTO-CREATES the parent skill. Every update = a new **immutable
  `SkillVersion`**. Parent `Skill` tracks **`default_version`** and **`latest_version`**.
  => Promoting a new default is a **METADATA-ONLY REPOINT** that silently changes behaviour for every
     agent/toolbox referencing the skill UNPINNED. Pinned-vs-floating is a discoverable property.
- CRUD: `POST|GET|DELETE {endpoint}/skills[/{name}[/versions[/{v}]]]`, `GET .../content` (ZIP).
  Create from `inline_content` JSON or multipart ZIP upload.
- **Required preview header on EVERY call: `Foundry-Features: Skills=V1Preview`.**
  Bearer token scope `https://ai.azure.com/.default`. RBAC: **Foundry User** on the project.
- **TWO DELIVERY MODES:**
  1) Attach to a toolbox -> skills surface as **MCP Resources** under **SEP-2640** (the MCP Skills
     extension). Client calls `resources/list` at startup, `resources/read` for content.
     Microsoft: "**any MCP client — GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, or your own agent harness — can
     consume skills this way without any Foundry SDK**."
     => FOUNDRY IS A SKILL DISTRIBUTION POINT FOR NON-MICROSOFT AGENTS. Instruction text governed in
        a Foundry project executes in clients Foundry cannot see; the Foundry-side inventory is the
        only place that reach is enumerable. Same-project only; no cross-project refs.
  2) Direct download into a hosted/local agent project; `SKILL.md` read at startup and injected as
     extra system instructions per session.
- **Prebuilt catalog** in the VS Code Foundry Toolkit, registerable from a card (no procurement step):
  Office docs (`docx`,`pptx`,`xlsx`,`pdf`); Design (`canvas-design`,`algorithmic-art`,
  `brand-guidelines`,`theme-factory`); Writing (`doc-coauthoring`,`internal-comms`,
  `slack-gif-creator`).
- **LIMITATION: no private networking.** The Skills API is NOT reachable over a private endpoint —
  a Foundry resource with public network access disabled cannot create/manage/download skills at all.
  Adopting skills therefore requires a network-posture concession.
- Destructive-op trap: `azd ai skill create --force` DELETES the existing skill and ALL its versions
  before uploading. `azd ai skill update` rejects `.zip`.
- Microsoft's caution: "Customers are responsible for understanding the behaviors of any skills
  deployed and the data handling practices of any external endpoints receiving data."
                    [reported 2026-08-23, MEDIUM/AISPM — flagged as coverage-gap recovery, not new]

## New detail on ALREADY-REPORTED capabilities (recorded, no finding)
- **`reminder_preview`** (self-scheduling; the capability was reported 2026-08-09 inside Routines).
  Args: `minutes` integer **1 - 43,200 (30 days)**; `input` string = instructions for the
  re-invocation. **Connectionless** — no external service, no authentication. **Hosted agents only**
  (NOT prompt agents). Must be added to a toolbox, then the toolbox attached to the agent. Foundry
  creates a **scheduled routine** that re-invokes the SAME agent **on the SAME conversation**,
  preserving context — unlike regular routines, which start new conversations.
  Created via `project.toolboxes.create_version(...)` / `POST {endpoint}/toolboxes/{name}/versions
  ?api-version=v1` with tool `type: reminder_preview`; agent manifest references
  `kind: toolbox, url: .../agents/toolboxes/{name}/mcp?version=N`.
- **Foundry RBAC roles were RENAMED** (role IDs and permissions unchanged; old names still visible
  in places): Azure AI User -> **Foundry User**; Azure AI Owner -> **Foundry Owner**;
  Azure AI Account Owner -> **Foundry Account Owner**; Azure AI Project Manager -> **Foundry Project
  Manager**. => display-name matching on Foundry roles will break; match on role ID.
- Toolbox how-to page has advanced: ms.date **2026-08-17**, updated_at **2026-08-18**.

## Carried forward — reported 2026-08-14
Incoming A2A endpoints (`enable-agent-to-agent-endpoint`; **Foundry serves A2A v0.3 by default when
the caller omits a version**); managed MCP servers powered by connector namespaces (1,000+
connectors, real endpoint on `logic.azure.com`, **no validation gating on the REST/SDK/azd path**);
sensitive trace content moving to the **`AppGenAIContent`** table by **2026-09-30**; Foundry Canvas;
Notification Center.
